notice: Demo fixture, SIM except the presenter's demo-operator record (LIVE). Loads only through `crew-health demo reset`. Every value is read from the file it cites; nothing here is seed data for a real mission.
basis: docs/product/VALIDATION.md section 3 (frozen start state) and docs/product/DEMO-PLAN.md sections 3 and 5

operator.basis: DEMO-PLAN 5: the operator, off camera with the operator role, resets the fixture and runs the cues

mission_day.basis: VALIDATION 3: Mara Okafor, SIM, flight day 19 of 30

presenter.basis: VALIDATION 3: a separate LIVE demo-operator record for the presenter; DEMO-PLAN 5 point 1

surface_walk.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 3: Ilya Brandt and Sofia Reyes are in an eva overlay on surface walk 1 until 11:40; DEMO-PLAN times are UTC-3

release.basis: the repository's own config/ release (config/kit-map.json, 119 rows, with D22's condition ID variants), activated at first start as a station hub activates it

time_confirmation.basis: operator confirmation against the demo laptop's clock, as the E01 serve tests confirm it

ground-link-down.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 3: GroundLink down, next_contact_at 26 hours ahead, gap_planned true, planned_line_of_sight, demo_switch

ground-link-schedule.basis: requests.schema.json GroundLinkDemoSwitch: return to the profile's schedule

model-stop.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 6: the presenter stops the model

model-start.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 6: the model is started again

eva-ilya.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 3 and DEMO-PLAN 3 (0:13): Ilya Brandt, medical officer, is on a surface walk; the surface_walk section names who and which overlay

environment-lunar-surface.basis: VALIDATION 3 act 3: a second EnvironmentProfile, lunar_surface, SIM, entered through the demo control

environment.basis: VALIDATION 3: environment for acts 1 and 2 is station_leo, SIM; flight day 19 of 30

camera.basis_worker_port: SYSTEM 3: the camera worker listens on 127.0.0.1:8091

twin.basis: AGENTS 4 and E06: the camera twin's synthetic video with a known injected pulse, declared SIM; never a person's webcam clip

cameras.name: Camera twin
cameras.basis: Coordinator 2026-11-15: the twin paired with Mara's station so its readings arrive labeled SIM

habitat.basis: E23 5.2 and 5.3: the NASA OSDR RR-1 ISS CO2 replay (N02) and the habitat packet twin's SIM CO2, each through the real habitat adapter and ingestReadings on the channel registry's channel; the registry names each adapter and its health URL port
